title: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11 fail to scope an incoming webhook's direct message target to the webhook's own…
description: Mattermost versions 11.7.x up to and including 11.7.11 contain a vulnerability where incoming webhook direct message targets are not properly scoped to the webhook's own team. This flaw allows a team administrator to send direct messages to users on teams they do not have authority over by using a webhook that has posting identities in multiple teams. The vulnerability has a low severity rating and does not impact confidentiality or availability, only integrity to a limited extent.
